svg.title: Human male front-arm frame reference — hair male1
svg.desc: Original Starbound human male pixels. 34 named target cells, 34 unique frame IDs. Embedded PNGs are reference artwork, not an importable template. Aliases refer to the same named target cell. Unused cells contain no image. Game artwork remains property of its original rights holders.
svg.metadata: Source package: /home/fleurs/Code/OpenStarbound/assets/packed.pak. Source image: /humanoid/human/frontarm.png (387x301). Frame document: /humanoid/frontarm.frames. Target: core character_layout(frontArm) 387x301, 43x43 top-down cells. Reference policy: actual named human canonical pose at source .frames coordinates; alpha-zero RGB normalized to zero, matching existing reference images. Distinct source poses have distinct frame IDs; aliases remain on their named target cell.
svg.text: Human male / hair male1 — front-arm reference
Target PNG 387 x 301; cells 43 x 43; 34 named cells / 34 IDs. Coordinates are top-down PNG pixels.
Original human body/arm layer only; other body layers, head and hair are intentionally absent.
Each named pose uses its actual source frame; distinct body/arm poses have separate IDs.
Aliases (= names) use their named cell. Empty grid cells are unused; do not paint them.
REFERENCE ONLY — not a PNG import template. Game pixels: original rights holders; no art relicensing.
